facility_desc: 1M+ sq ft fulfillment center, Matrix Business Park (developer KTR NJ Urban Renewal LLC; Amazon tenant)
program: Long-term tax exemption PILOT (N.J.S.A. 40A:20) with urban renewal entity
issuer: Robbinsville Township Council (reported via NJ Governor's Office release)
notes: Source says council offered the developer a 20-yr PILOT 'worth $13.755 million'; meaning (value of exemption vs payments) not defined. Investment (130M, 2 centers) and 1,500 jobs are announced and 'contingent on incentives'. A Trentonian excerpt gives PILOT payments of $600,000/yr for 20 yrs (about 12M; payments, not subsidy). Township page reportedly says >22M revenue over 20 yrs (page not retrievable). Ordinance text and financial agreement not found. 2012 deal also tied to Amazon starting 7% NJ sales tax collection July 2013 (state estimate ~30M/yr revenue); not a facility subsidy. No clawback info found.

facility_desc: Planned ~1M sq ft single-story automated fulfillment/middle-mile facility, former Atlantic City Race Course; target open 2028
program: 29-year PILOT / Financial Agreement (redevelopment area), Long Term Tax Exemption Law
issuer: Township of Hamilton Township Committee (approved unanimously, reported 2026-07-08)
notes: Amount is DERIVED: ~223M taxes without PILOT (township attorney, per press) minus ~123M PILOT payments = ~100M foregone. Township's own info sheet (primary, saved) confirms estimated Annual Service Charge ~$123,057,621 (municipal share ~$94.83M) and ~750 jobs, but not the 223M counterfactual. Also a separate $10M Amazon-funded community trust (payment by Amazon, not a subsidy). Site not yet in facilities.csv (not built). Facility is not yet operating; no clawback terms found. Township says data-center conversion would void the PILOT.
